editorial.blurb: This lively hot pot experience delivers theatrical dining with a rotating conveyor belt of 60+ ingredients, fresh meats, and customizable broths that make every visit feel like an adventure.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or call ahead for the waitlist (peak times have 20+ minute waits); order the top package for 90 minutes of unlimited access, use the iPad to call your train deliveries, and don't skip the sauce bar where you can mix your own or try housemade options.
